templates.name: CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP
templates.description: CGP Certificate Manager local monitoring via an existing public node_exporter endpoint. Requires manager monitoring metrics; no private files, root UserParameters, sudo, CGP, Cloudflare or ACME access. Local certificate expiry and saved manager state are observations, not proof of deployed TLS. Validates the complete metric structure before discovery. Operational signals require fresh complete data, and recovery expressions prevent stale or partial observations from clearing existing problems. No actions or notifications are configured. Offline schema contracts and ES5 preprocessing are tested; actual Zabbix 7.0 import/server acceptance remains a deployment check.

items.name: CGP: Raw public metrics
items.description: GET the existing node_exporter public endpoint. No CGP, Cloudflare, ACME, private files, local commands, or privileged agent checks. Restrict endpoint access to the monitoring network.

items.name: CGP: Validated local snapshot
items.description: Native Prometheus parsing followed by bounded, strict one-hot and series validation. Unknown quantities are absent. Raw metric input is never used as a discovery list.

items.name: CGP: Fresh local snapshot
items.description: Rejects stale or future observations. Operational fields exist only for complete collections; diagnostic source and certificate read status may exist on partial collections.

items.name: CGP: Local collection time
items.description: Time the local files were observed, not a live TLS verification. Retained even for stale snapshots so stale/future collection timestamps are diagnosed. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

triggers.name: CGP: Public monitoring data unavailable
triggers.description: No fresh validated public snapshot arrived in the no-data interval. Includes HTTP failure, absent metrics, malformed metrics, and failed freshness preprocessing.

triggers.name: CGP: Local monitoring snapshot is stale
triggers.description: The collection timestamp is older than the permitted age. Existing operational problems require fresh, complete evidence before recovery.
triggers.recovery_expression: (floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))

triggers.name: CGP: Local monitoring timestamp is in the future
triggers.description: Collection time is ahead of the Zabbix clock beyond the configured tolerance. Check both clocks.
triggers.recovery_expression: (floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))

items.name: CGP: Accepted collection time
items.description: Exact floating-point collection timestamp accepted by the strict JavaScript freshness gate. Must equal the raw generation before cached global values can be used. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

items.name: CGP: Collection completeness
items.description: 1 means all required local sources were read, not that TLS or the server is healthy.

triggers.expression: (floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=0
triggers.name: CGP: Local monitoring collection is incomplete
triggers.description: One or more local sources or public certificate reads could not be collected. No partial snapshot is accepted as an empty discovery list.
triggers.recovery_expression: ((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1)

discovery_rules.name: CGP: Local domain discovery
discovery_rules.description: Fresh complete local observations only. Partial, malformed, stale and future observations fail preprocessing; they never become an empty list. Lost resources are never disabled or deleted automatically. Review removed domains manually. Discovery is bounded to 1000 domains.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Observation time
item_prototypes.description: Current local observation time for this domain, not live discovery or TLS validation. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Enabled policy
item_prototypes.description: Current local configuration; disabled domains remain discovered. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Local certificate read status
item_prototypes.description: Public local leaf read result. Readable does not mean valid, installed, trusted, or served by CGP. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: In saved inventory
item_prototypes.description: Presence in last saved inventory, not a live CGP query. Unknown is unsupported. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Local certificate expiry
item_prototypes.description: Expiry of the public local leaf certificate. Unknown or unreadable certificate produces no expiry value. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Last saved successful operation
item_prototypes.description: Historical successful manager deployment or unchanged check, not current TLS proof. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Saved stage failure count
item_prototypes.description: Saved failure count for the last failed stage; not a cumulative counter. Unknown is unsupported. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Saved retry time
item_prototypes.description: Saved retry time; zero explicitly means cleared. Inspection is not deferred by this value. Configured lineage: {#CGP_CERT_NAME}. Numeric timestamps are Unix seconds; original fractional precision is retained.

item_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Saved failure count is known
item_prototypes.description: Presence flag for this exact observed generation: 1 means a saved failure count exists, 0 means unknown. This is not a failure count and never represents healthy zero.

trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Fresh local observations unavailable
trigger_prototypes.description: A previously enabled domain has no fresh observation. Lost discovery resources are retained and remain enabled until an operator reviews them.

trigger_prototypes.expression: ((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=2
trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Public local certificate cannot be read
trigger_prototypes.description: An explicit local leaf read error may be reported even when the collection is incomplete. This does not perform a network TLS probe.
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: ((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 or last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])<>2)

trigger_prototypes.expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1
trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Public local certificate is missing
trigger_prototypes.description: A complete local observation established absence of the configured public leaf. An unreadable leaf or partial snapshot does not establish recovery.
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 or last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0)

trigger_prototypes.expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())<={$CGP.EXPIRY.CRIT.SECONDS}
trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Local certificate expiry is critical
trigger_prototypes.description: Configured critical threshold defaults to 7 days and includes already expired local certificates. This is not proof of the certificate served by CGP.
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 or (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())>{$CGP.EXPIRY.CRIT.SECONDS}))

trigger_prototypes.expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())>{$CGP.EXPIRY.CRIT.SECONDS} and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())<={$CGP.EXPIRY.WARN.SECONDS}
trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Local certificate expiry warning
trigger_prototypes.description: Warning and critical bands are disjoint. Defaults: more than 7 days and at most 21 days remaining on the local certificate.
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 or (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.certificate_status["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 and ((last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())<={$CGP.EXPIRY.CRIT.SECONDS} or (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.not_after["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])-now())>{$CGP.EXPIRY.WARN.SECONDS})))

trigger_prototypes.expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.failures_known["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.failures["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])>0
trigger_prototypes.name: CGP {#CGP_DOMAIN}: Saved stage failures need review
trigger_prototypes.description: Historical saved failure count, not live health. Only an explicit fresh complete value can resolve this problem.
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: (((floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<=now()+{$CGP.FUTURE.SKEW.SECONDS} and now()-floor(last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp))<={$CGP.MAX.AGE.SECONDS} and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.accepted)=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.observed["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.timestamp)) and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.collection.success)=1) and (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.enabled["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0 or (last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.failures_known["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=1 and last(/CGP Certificate Manager by HTTP/cgp.manager.domain.failures["{#CGP_DOMAIN}"])=0))

macros.description: Existing public node_exporter endpoint reachable by Zabbix server/proxy. This is not a CGP administrative URL. Prefer HTTPS where available; peer and hostname verification are enabled. Redirects are refused.
HTTP polling interval. Keep below the collection freshness and no-data intervals.
Maximum collection age, inclusive. Administrator-owned decimal integer seconds only, 1 to 99999999; inserted into JavaScript. No expressions or quotes.
Permitted future clock skew, inclusive. Administrator-owned decimal integer seconds only, 0 to 99999999; inserted into JavaScript. Default 0 matches Prometheus/Grafana. No expressions or quotes.
Alert after this interval without validated metrics or a previously enabled domain observation.
Critical local certificate expiry threshold in seconds. Default 7 days. Keep below the warning threshold.
Warning local certificate expiry threshold in seconds. Default 21 days; warning excludes the critical band.
